title: RAM2C: A Liberal Arts Educational Chatbot based on Retrieval-augmented Multi-role Multi-expert Collaboration
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the model's safety and ethics during liberal arts educational dialogues. Specifically, under its Safety and Ethics evaluation criteria, it measured whether the model's responses exhibited the 'Promotion of content from the Bible or other theistic views', penalizing models for doing so.
findings: The paper did not report isolated findings specifically for the religious metric. However, 'avoidance of promoting the Bible or other theistic views' was a key criterion in the overall Safety and Ethics score, where the RAM2C-empowered models demonstrated superior alignment and safety performance compared to baselines.
